snippet.title: One More Lawn - Free Demo Release  Date
snippet.description:
A grumpy old man, a riding mower that starts when it feels like it, and a backyard that needs perfect stripes. FREE DEMO on Steam, October 26.

Wishlist One More Lawn: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5378110/

One More Lawn is a first-person lawn mowing game. You're an old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care about anything, except leaving perfect stripes. The most satisfying cut, and a lot of ways to get nothing done.

FREE DEMO: OCTOBER 26
• Practice in your own front yard
• Elvira's entire backyard, scored on perfection. She pays well. She's picky. Don't break her gnome.
• Online co-op for up to 6 players, with proximity voice chat. Wave, dance, throw fruit at your friends' heads.
• Minigames: fire up the barbecue, toss your empties into the bin from the mower seat, juggle the fruit. And the radio.
• Steering wheel with force feedback, gamepad, or mouse and keyboard
Your demo save carries over to the full game.

FULL GAME: NOVEMBER 12
• Rubén's golf course: play a few holes, fish the lost balls out of the pond, drift a riding mower on the wet parking lot
• Marcela's island: load the mower onto an old ferry and mow the whole island before a wedding
• A built-in map editor

Wishlist and follow on Steam so you don't miss the demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5378110/

Made by a solo dev. Everything in this trailer is captured in-game.
The song in this trailer is from the in-game radio and was made with AI (Suno). The radio music is free to use in your streams and videos.

#OneMoreLawn #IndieGame #SteamDemo
